title: agents-flex/agents-flex

title: hassamwaleed/agent-orchestrator-framework
description: Turn Your AI Agent Into a Full Developer Team: Plan, Code, Test & Ship in One Sprint 2026

title: EduardEdi14/Proiect_AgentAI_ProductManager
description: My AI agent is a virtual assistant built in Python, designed to act as an experienced Product Manager. The project leverages LLMs (Large Language Models) integrated with a Function Calling / Tools framework, allowing the AI to autonomously calculate and analyze key business and product performance indicators (KPIs).

title: hjiang13/awesome-Large-Language-Model-4-IRs-in-Compiler
description: A curated list of research papers, datasets, tools, and benchmarks on applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to Compiler Intermediate Representations (IR) and Optimization.

title: wafaashour499/Egyptian-Artifacts-Assistant
description: An AI-powered Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that enables users to explore Egyptian museum artifacts through semantic search and natural language question answering using ChromaDB, Sentence Transformers, Groq, and Streamlit.

title: NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM
description: TensorRT LLM provides users with an easy-to-use Python API to define Large Language Models (LLMs) and supports state-of-the-art optimizations to perform inference efficiently on NVIDIA GPUs. TensorRT LLM also contains components to create Python and C++ runtimes that orchestrate the inference execution in a performant way.

title: xLLM-AI/xllm
description: A high-performance inference engine for LLM, VLM, DiT and REC models, optimized for diverse AI accelerators. It is hosted in OpenAtom Foundation.
